main_text.p: uarum victoriam reportavit, ut LXXXM Britannorum perirent. Successor ipsi datus Petronius Turpilianus, non irritato hoste, neque laedi[?]tus ... [illegible, ~12 letters] ... Aoquinum id liceret Polycletus libertus in ... Dax & exercitum tanti belli confectior servitus obedientibus.
In SCOTIA excepit Corbredum Dardanus, [illegible, ~20 letters] nevos, qui initio iniuria ... medium ... gentes ... exacto ... omnia vitiorum ... probatus est. De eo in frequentibus plura.

Floruerunt tum Libo Mendax Cosda[?]. qui sub Caligula, cum caedem egregie infe- ... ceteris, immortalis periculum ... Iberis ... liberatus est; quique intra quadriennium ... tredecim millionibus paravit dictum.cap. 4 Venit jubente Nerone, veni incisus, & hausto veneno. Putatur Gellio minutin verborum ... frangere pondera, C. Bathybius Zeptis ... Acutus, qui auctor est, Heracleotes ... fibi fuisse Delphinorum à mari oceano Cucurbitarum & Crocodilorum à flumine advenas agmen agentium velut pro partibus praelium: ... los ab animalibus placidis, & morsu in- ... os.

Pamphila genere Aegyptia, ... historiae miscellae cripsit, quam vel ex ... quarto, vel ex ejus amicis audivit, vel ipsa obsequia ... Demonax, Admetus, Alexius, Philopoemen Babylonius; Pyrrhus, eques Romanus ... vereundi & virginalis, qui Cernuus prae- ... fuo HS, vicies centena milia, ad ... exacte ... compulsant, LM Coronatorum Gallicus.

page.notes: Page is a scan of a worn, partly illegible printed page; many words are conjectural and are left as illegible placeholders where the scan does not allow a reliable reading. Right margin and left margin notes are mostly illegible. Bottom: "Hh j" gathering signature and "rum" fragment.
